canada.title: Health officials reflect on ‘lasting impact,’ heroic response following CFB Wainwright fire
canada.summary: More than a month after a deadly fire engulfed a training range at Canadian Forces Base Wainwright, Alberta health officials are expected to provide an update on the soldiers still recovering from the flames.

canada.title: Ontario will soon require licence, registration, insurance for some e-bikes
canada.summary: Some e-bike drivers will soon have to get a driver’s licence, vehicle registration and insurance to ride on Ontario's roads, Transportation Minister Prabmeet Sarkaria announced Wednesday.

canada.title: Snowfall warnings issued for some B.C. Interior highways
canada.summary: Environment Canada has issued snowfall warnings for some B.C. Interior highways. The alerts are in place for the Okanagan Connector between Merritt and Kelowna and the Coquihalla Highway between Hope and Merritt, as well as Highway 3 from Paulson Summit to Kootenay Pass.

canada.title: Brandon man assaulted in early November has died from injuries, police say
canada.summary: A 66-year-old man who sustained a fractured skull and brain bleed when he was assaulted on Nov. 3 in Brandon died this week, police say.

canada.title: Shelter-in-place order issued for parts of Longueuil, Que., after fire near Sainte-Julie
canada.summary: The City of Sainte-Julie on Montreal's South Shore is urging residents to close their windows and stay indoors if possible due to what looks like a major fire. Parts of Longueuil, Que. are also under a shelter-in-place order.

canada.title: Yukon government shoots down electoral reform bill
canada.summary: The bill, tabled by interim Liberal Leader Debra-Leigh Reti, would have amended the Elections Act to replace the existing first-past-the-post voting system with ranked ballots, where voters choose candidates in order of preference.

canada.title: Halifax-area cocaine trafficker with 'extravagant lifestyle' sentenced to 8 years
canada.summary: Gary Michael “Boo” Boudreau, who a target of a major cocaine and cannabis investigation in 2020, was sentenced Wednesday in Halifax provincial court, with Judge Elizabeth Buckle concluding he profited greatly from his crimes.

canada.title: 2 arrested after investigation into series of home invasions across GTA: Peel police
canada.summary: Two people have been charged as the result of an investigation into an alleged spree of home invasions, Peel Regional Police announced Thursday.
